notes.title: Introducing The Golden Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27457570/962362dc778f8c791379c04b10ad2a65b73a7230.png[/img]

Featuring two new games and a shower of updates! It's very late and very big, but hopefully very worth it!

Steal some gold from a mildly secure vault, or mine it yourself just like in that one game with all the Lego-looking squares my little nephew plays on his phone! Also engage in very fun activities including, and limited to: listening to music in the menu, not hitting the ball so hard in tennis that it goes through your racket but still makes a noise, and still carefully avoiding shooting the Princess in The Bow and Arrow game. 

 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27485220/08fc1abd24624a89f54b1f95e08ba26a26f405ae.png[/img]



Find out more in the changelog right here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/579970/announcements/detail/233465047945785357

Love,

Ivan_
